derived_cause: The portal entry name is a moving value that SUBMISSION_DOSSIER.md wrote into present-tense INSTRUCTION text, so when the value moved the dossier did not. Section 5b0 was added on 2026-07-28 at 08:41 by commit 27782d2 and pinned the submission target as `future-spinner-2` in the imperative body of the upload procedure (SUBMISSION_DOSSIER.md:206-209 at e3206c9 = 221-224 at HEAD, plus 5b step 1 at 231/246). Five hours later on the same day, commit e3206c9 (2026-07-28 13:43) moved the destination to the clean-baseline entry `future-spinner-3` for the V10 visit. That commit touched exactly three files, OWNER_CHECKLIST.md, VERSION and docs/records/upload-kit/00_READ_ME_FIRST.md, and did NOT touch SUBMISSION_DOSSIER.md, so the checklist's item 3 (OWNER_CHECKLIST.md:61-65 at e3206c9) read `Upload to future-spinner-3` while the dossier still read `THE SUBMISSION ENTRY IS future-spinner-2`. Two present-tense instructions tracking the same moving name, updated by two different commits, therefore disagreed head-on: that is the cited contradiction. This is precisely the failure class CLAUDE.md convention (s) names on 2026-07-30 (CLAUDE.md:1044-1056), but the (s) repair, commit d12c632, de-named the moving values in OWNER_CHECKLIST.md, App.svelte, kit_build.mjs and owner_preview.mjs only and again did not touch SUBMISSION_DOSSIER.md. So the defect did not close, it changed shape: at HEAD the checklist deliberately names no entry (OWNER_CHECKLIST.md:27, 111-112), the live walkthrough PART 9i, which OWNER_CHECKLIST.md:110 states is the only PART 9 heading not marked SUPERSEDED, directs the upload to `future-spinner-3` and says only `future-spinner-3` should remain (docs/records/upload-kit/00_READ_ME_FIRST.md:1111, 1117, 1164), and SUBMISSION_DOSSIER.md is the last present-tense instruction in the repository still naming a portal entry, and it names the superseded one. Root mechanism, in one sentence: a compliance instruction was anchored to a value that changes, and the update of that value was applied per-document rather than at its single source, so the document that was not in the update commit kept the stale name and became a live instruction to submit to the wrong portal entry.

The commit that introduced future-spinner-3 (e3206c9, 2026-07-28 13:43) is five hours after the commit that wrote future-spinner-2 into the dossier (27782d2, 2026-07-28 08:41) and does not include SUBMISSION_DOSSIER.md in its file list, which is the direct, checkable mechanism. The later convention (s) repair (d12c632, 2026-07-30) likewise omits the dossier, which is why the contradiction survives at HEAD in the asymmetric form: checklist names no entry, walkthrough names future-spinner-3, dossier still instructs the reader to open future-spinner-2.
